beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:c5.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:c5.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE Fresh off a $225M Series C, we're acquiring companies at pace and the hiring demand that comes with it is real. We're looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter who can operate at that velocity without sacrificing quality. You'll own full-cycle recruiting across engineering and product for Beacon and its portfolio companies, working directly with technical leaders to build teams in markets like Toronto, San Francisco, and New York. What You'll Be Doing - Full-cycle ownership. From first outreach to signed offer across engineering, product, and adjacent functions. You run the process; you don't hand it off. - Strategic partnership. You'll work directly with engineering and product leaders to build hiring strategies that fit today's market, not last year's playbook. - Creative sourcing. LinkedIn is the floor, not the ceiling. GitHub, niche communities, your own network, and AI-assisted tooling are all in play. - Operational rigor. We use Ashby and we take our data seriously. Clean pipelines, tight feedback loops, and disciplined process are non-negotiable. - The close. You know how to navigate comp conversations and competing offers without losing your composure or your candidate. - Brand building. You'll help tell the Beacon story in the markets we're hiring in and make candidates want to be part of what we're building. What You Bring - 7+ years of technical recruiting experience with a track record of senior engineering hires that you're proud of. - Comfort in high-growth, fast-changing environments. You don't need a manual; you're happy to write one. - Technical fluency. You can calibrate on engineering talent without needing a hiring manager to hold your hand. - Communication that's polished and authentic, whether it's cold outreach or a high-stakes offer call. - Self-direction. You know how to prioritize, manage your time, and deliver without being supervised. - Hands-on experience with Ashby or Greenhouse. - BA/BS degree. Bonus Points - You've recruited PMs and understand what makes a great one. - Agency background. You know what urgency feels like and you don't need to manufacture it. - An active Greater Toronto Area network in the startup/tech ecosystem. - You've built interview rubrics and calibration processes from scratch because you believe in a fair, data-driven bar. Our Values at Beacon Software - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our ap

cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:d4b42193-4a92-47.title: Property Manager (Residential)
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:d4b42193-4a92-47.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The Residential Property Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and operations of the property. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, leading the on-site team, oversight of daily activities, residential satisfaction and high level of customer service, achieving budgeted financial goals, complete company required reporting and maintaining a best-in-class appearance of the property. This position will set goals to integrate leasing, property management, building maintenance, and resident retention activities that positively impact the overall success of the property. Annually draft a budget and business plan for review and approval. Additionally, they will manage to the property’s approved budget with an emphasis on timely rent collection, meeting monthly leasing goals, resident retention, expense and revenue management, and vendor supervision.
responsibilities: Supervise on-site staff including administrative support employee(s), maintenance team, leasing team, security, parking attendants, and other vendors as needed. Plan, organize, and manage employee focused activities including, but not limited to:
Compliance with all applicable employment laws as well as CIM Group employment policies and procedures.
Facilitate employee development and training opportunities that promote maximum productivity and position the employee for increased responsibilities and job growth.
Provide at a minimum an annual performance review, offering feedback/counseling along with, as required, appropriate on-site job training and be able to address job performance deficiencies.
Responsible for coordinating leasing coverage all days of the week including weekends.
Responsible for performing all other duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by your supervisor.
qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
Knowledgeable of general accounting practices, accrual-based accounting, and reserving for bad debt.
Five years prior experience working in a residential property manager capacity.
Must possess a valid state-issued driver’s license.
Brokerage License or Real Estate Salesperson License preferred; or willingness to receive license within first 90 days of employment.
COMMUNICATION SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:
Read and interpret documents such as office equipment maintenance and instruction manuals, company SOP documents.
Ability to write correspondence and reports in a concise and detailed manner.
Ability to effectively present information to residents, vendors, contractors, and other employees of the organization.
Ability to analyze and interpret lease agreements, financial reports, and legal documents.
Respond to common inquiries or complaints from residents, regulatory agencies, other areas of the company, and members of the business community.
Good verbal communication.
Organization and ability to multitask efficiently.
Problem solving to find effective solutions for variety of potential issues.
Able to motivate and effectively manage the building team.
MATHEMATICAL SKILL REQUIREMENTS:
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide.
Ability to compute rate, ratio, and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
Ability to calculate discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
Ability to calculate monthly and year-to-date financial variances.
REASONING SKILL REQUIREMENTS:
Ability to apply common-sense understanding to carry out instructions.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:
MS Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Familiar with Nexus Payables or similar software applications.
Familiar with Yardi or similar software applications.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:35.title: Production Support Technician - Eunice (Day Shift)
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:35.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel has an opening for a Night Shift Production Support Technician at our Eunice, LA. plant. This position supports both Kinetic and Laser cutting operations by ensuring materials are safely transported, staged, prepared, and delivered throughout the manufacturing process. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, dependable, and enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
responsibilities: Safely operate forklifts, overhead cranes, hoists, and other material handling equipment.
Transport, stage, load, and unload steel materials to support production.
Support Kinetic and Laser cutting operations by delivering raw materials and removing finished components.
Prepare, inspect, clean, sort, and stage finished parts for downstream fabrication.
Load, align, and position steel plates for cutting operations.
Remove scrap, excess material, templates, and cut components without damaging finished products.
Use basic hand tools including scrapers, wire brushes, grinders, hammers, crowbars, and brooms as needed.
Verify part accuracy against work orders, drawings, and specifications.
Perform pre- and post-operation inspections on forklifts and lifting equipment.
Maintain accurate production records and inventory movement.
Perform general housekeeping and other duties as assigned
qualifications: High School Diploma or GED preferred.
Ability to read a tape measure required.
Ability to read basic fabrication drawings preferred.
Prior forklift, warehouse, or manufacturing experience preferred.
Knowledge of basic hand tools.
Ability to safely perform medium-heavy physical labor in indoor and outdoor manufacturing environments.
Ability to work in varying temperatures while wearing required PPE.
Clear Motor Vehicle Report.
Regular, reliable attendance required.

You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Help develop and maintain automated documentation testing, validation processes, and CI/CD workflows where applicable. Comfortable working with the Linux command line and developer tools such as Git, GCC, and GDB. Understanding of distributed systems and/or database server development. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively within a globally distributed organization. Strong collaboration skills and experience communicating through tools such as Slack, Jira, Notion, Zoom, mailing lists, and community forums. Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and contribute positively as part of a distributed team. A developer or DevOps background is highly valued. Our partner is looking for a Senior iOS Developer based in Spain. This is an opportunity to build a next-generation mobile financial product at the intersection of traditional finance and decentralized technology. You’ll take ownership of the iOS experience for an application bringing investing, trading, staking, and digital assets together in one platform. The role combines polished mobile product development with demanding requirements around security, reliability, and real-time financial data. You’ll work extensively with Swift and SwiftUI while integrating secure wallet functionality and transaction signing flows. Close collaboration with backend, product, and design teams will allow you to shape both the technical architecture and user experience. You’ll join a fast-moving remote startup environment where autonomy, technical ownership, and strong communication are highly valued. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced iOS engineer interested in fintech, blockchain, and building consumer-facing financial technology from the ground up. Design, develop, and maintain a high-quality iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI. Build intuitive and reliable interfaces for complex financial workflows, including staking, trading, portfolio management, and digital asset exposure. Implement secure wallet integrations and transaction-signing flows with a strong focus on protecting user assets and data. Integrate RESTful and WebSocket APIs to support reliable communication with backend services and real-time financial information. Optimize application performance, stability, security, and responsiveness across supported iOS devices. Contribute to mobile architecture decisions and help maintain scalable, maintainable application structures. Participate in code reviews and uphold high standards for code quality, testing, and engineering practices. Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate requirements into polished, user-friendly experiences. Monitor developments in the iOS ecosystem and evaluate relevant platform updates, APIs, and capabilities for integration into the product. Take ownership of technical challenges and contribute proactively to the evolution of the mobile product in a fast-paced startup environment. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience developing iOS applications. Strong hands-on proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI. Solid understanding of iOS security best practices, including Keychain, biometric authentication, and secure data storage. Practical experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with real-time data through WebSockets. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture patterns such as MVVM and Clean Architecture. Experience building production-quality applications with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities and a high degree of ownership. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges. Good written and spoken English communication skills. Experience developing fintech, trading, banking, or other financial applications is a strong advantage. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, and design stakeholders in a remote environment. You will shape and scale payment testing solutions for complex, enterprise-grade transaction environments. The role combines technical architecture, commercial strategy, client advisory, and delivery leadership. You will design offerings, methodologies, staffing models, and pricing while solving sophisticated payment-quality challenges. Working closely with clients, sales, delivery teams, and technology partners, you will influence high-impact business opportunities. Lead thought leadership: Represent the payments testing vision through white papers, articles, webinars, conference presentations, industry discussions, and other external communications. Influence without direct authority: Inspire and coordinate distributed, cross-functional teams while building strong relationships with technical specialists, business leaders, clients, and partners. thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.title: Urology Physician, Tallahassee, FL
thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Advanced Institute of Urology (AUI) - powered by Urology Alliance. As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), Advanced Institute of Urology (AUI) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers Advanced Institute of Urology (AUI) to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Why Join AUI in Tallahassee? Immediate patient volume as senior physicians retire Physician-owned surgery center for greater autonomy, efficiency, and ancillary income Partnership and equity ownership at no cost to you – a unique path to build wealth and share in practice success Busy practice from day one with strong referral networks and loyal patient base Autonomy in your practice with the security of Florida’s leading physician-led urology group Modern facilities and advanced technology designed for efficient, high-quality care Competitive compensation and benefits plus leadership pathways and career advancement opportunities What You’ll Do Deliver comprehensive urologic care to a diverse and established patient population Perform surgeries and outpatient procedures in a physician-owned surgery center Collaborate with an experienced team of urologists, APPs, and clinical staff Build your career in a practice designed for growth, stability, and long-term success Who We’re Looking For Board-certified or board-eligible urologists (general or subspecialty interests welcome) Practicing physicians or residents/fellows Patient-focused clinicians with excellent communication skills Team-oriented professionals eager to carry forward a thriving community practice Why Tallahassee is the Place to Be: Known as the "Capital City," Tallahassee is a vibrant Florida gem that perfectly blends Southern hospitality with a high-energy center of government and education. It is a place where you can stroll beneath centuries-old live oak canopies in the morning and engage with cutting-edge research at a world-class laboratory by the afternoon. With a metro population of approximately 390,000, Tallahassee is large enough to host major universities and national conferences, yet small enough to maintain a lush, hilly, and community-focused atmosphere. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:d4db6fdb-fd4.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level Portuguese (BR) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level Portuguese (BR) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $35.00 USD per hour
